[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Unique paths II** [LC 63 · Unique Paths II](https://leetcode.com/problems/unique-paths-ii/){difficulty="Medium"}

Every path into $(r, c)$ arrives from $(r-1, c)$ or from $(r, c-1)$, and those two groups are disjoint, so the counts add. An obstacle cell has 0 paths into it, which automatically blocks everything that would pass through it.

[Solved in full in @sec-dpi-p3-unique.]{.card-link}
